learning_outcomes.text: Explain core CRM concepts and how Salesforce objects, records and relationships model a business
Manage users, profiles, roles and permissions following least privilege
Customise objects, fields, page layouts and record types to fit a process
Control data visibility with org-wide defaults, sharing rules and the role hierarchy
Automate simple processes with declarative tools and validation
Maintain data quality and produce reports and dashboards for stakeholders

integrative_case: A growing non-profit adopts Salesforce for donor management: model donors and gifts as objects, set up users with least-privilege access, control who can see sensitive records, customise layouts and a validation rule for a stewardship process, import and de-duplicate existing data, and build a dashboard the director reviews each week.
design_assumption_note: n/a - general professional skills course, no external standard claimed
version_basis: No issuer syllabus. Outcomes are Mastemy internal IDs derived from the course blueprint and teach durable, transferable platform concepts. Platform features, pricing and user interfaces change frequently; product specifics must be verified at production and on-screen steps may differ from any shown.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
